Public.scheduleSummary: League-local dates, venues, and the latest status for every scheduled game.
Public.resultsSummary: Final and forfeited games reflected exactly as they count in the standings.
Public.standingsSummary: Authoritative regular-season results under the league’s frozen ranking rules.

Auth.title: Sign in to the league desk.
Auth.summary: Authorized league administrators can run games, record or correct official results, and review the standings they produce.
Auth.invalid: That email and password did not match an authorized login.

Admin.title: Run the night from first tip to final.
Admin.summary: Schedule games in the league timezone, record official results and forfeits, correct mistakes with an audit trail, and see standings update immediately.
Admin.noScheduledGames: There are no scheduled or postponed games.
Admin.noGames: There are no in-progress games waiting for a result.
Admin.noCompletedGames: There are no official results yet.
Admin.invalidScore: Enter two different whole-number scores. Tied final results are prohibited.
Admin.invalidSchedule: That schedule could not be accepted. Check the teams, venue, and local time; daylight-saving gaps and overlaps require a different unambiguous time.
Admin.invalidGame: That game operation was invalid. The official records were left unchanged.
Admin.invalidCorrection: Enter a non-tied official score, matching winner, and a reason for the correction.
Admin.finalized: The result is official and the standings have been recalculated.
Admin.forfeited: The forfeit is official and the standings have been recalculated.
Admin.corrected: The corrected result is official, its prior value is preserved, and the standings have been recalculated.
Admin.scheduled: The game has been scheduled and its audit history recorded.
Admin.rescheduled: The game has been rescheduled and its prior schedule preserved.
Admin.cancelled: The game has been cancelled. It will not affect standings.
Admin.started: The game is now in progress and ready for its final score.
Admin.rejected: The result was not accepted. The official records were left unchanged.
Admin.unexpected: The result could not be saved. The official records were left unchanged.
Admin.noAccessSummary: This login is not linked to an active League Administrator assignment.
